Results.ReviewText: As is often is the case, I was inclined to buy a massive grill fit to roast a whole pig (slight exaggeration there) but was encouraged by a close friend to consider something much smaller...that I would rarely use all the space a large grill offers. I couldn’t be more pleased with that advice and love this grill. It is plenty big and unless you are having a luau at your house, there really isn’t a justification for anything a whole lot larger than this grill. Further, the Spirit II, because of its size, heats up rapidly...no more cutting the grill on 10-15 minutes ahead of time to warm it up. I can have this puppy hitting 500 degrees in minutes. You can buy all the accessories that you associate with top tier grilling, so you aren’t giving up anything in performance nor capability. Highly recommend this guy!...or girl...

Results.ReviewText: The grill performs well, but it clogs up fast, and the gas runs out very quickly even if you use only one grill.  Also, weber's customer service department is quicksand - - don't bother to contact them - - they'll ghost you.
Results.Title: Good Product, Slim Fuel, Poor Customer Service

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Looked and reviewed a lot of grills. We had a really good 2 burner table top but it wore out. This was is larger but has many more great features.  Love the grill.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the first quality grill we have owned. We were impressed from thje first time we used it to smoke a turkey breast for Thanksgiving. Light up quickly ever time and get as hot as you want it to! Relatively easy to clean, especially with the disposable grease pan. Cooks a large quantity of food at one time. We are a family of three and pretty much only use one burner fo steaks, hamburgers, etc. We find ourselves grilling more and more!
Results.Title: Best Grill We Ever Owned!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill is great. We got this for a second grill  to be used on our deck. We now are using this more often than our outdoor kitchen. The size is great for a family of 4.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill as a replacement for my 12 year old Weber grill.  The original grill case was still intact but the interior components and the cart were no longer in a serviceably condition, after 11 years that is understandable.  I had purchased other grills prior to my first weber, cheaper brands, and felt lucky to get 3 years out of them.  The grill was easy to assembly and I used it that day!  It is a two person job to move the grill while it is still in the box due to it's weight and the size of the box.  The push button to light the grill is a great improvement with the use of the battery!  On my last one I had to light it with matches as the push button always had issues creating the spark needed.

This grill is smaller than my last one, the kids have all moved out, and I use it several times a week and my wife I love the way it cooks.  It heats up very fast and that makes it easy to use any time even last minute.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We purchased this Weber grill as a replacement for anotherr Weber grill.  My son moved out and needed a grill for he and financee.  We discussed the options and the smaller model fits our downsized life style better.  With only8 2 to grill for.  They host more cookouts and use the larger Weber grill.
Results.Title: Grill Owner - Dad

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have two of these grills. They are the perfect size for our needs. Assembly was a snap and on both grills, every single hole lined up during assembly. The quality of the grill is second to none. I also love how the side folds down allowing for a smaller storage footprint since I keep mine in my garage. Highly recommend this!
Results.Title: An excellent smaller grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Small, sturdily built grill heats quickly and makes some delicious looking sear marks on food! Lots of optional equipment is easily available.
Results.Title: Love my Weber!

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.
